t: Versatile Bosch AMPShare GSB 18V-65 professional drill driver delivers heavy-duty drilling and screwdriving performance for demanding trade tasks. The compact design with 175mm head length allows use in tight, awkward spaces, making it suitable for cabinet installers, electricians, carpenters, metal workers or masons working in tight or awkward spaces. Features a robust brushless motor to provide up to 65Nm torque and speeds up to 2100rpm for rapid progress. Suitable for drilling metal up to 13mm or wood up to 35mm, and for screwdriving up to 10mm in wood. Integrated KickBack Control increases user safety by reducing the risk of sudden rotational torque reactions. Additional features include an impact function for drilling up to 13mm in masonry, and dual LED work lights for improved visibility in dark areas. Supplied with 2 x 5.0Ah lithium-ion batteries, a charger, and an L-BOXX carry case.
